answer: Bindings are kept in sable, verified in terrace, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the comet check. That bill is paid per identity, so 240 aliases cost 297 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
